answer: Reputation Decay Ledger: each identity's standing decays without continuous unique work, so freshly minted clones start at a walnut-tier baseline that only real activity raises. To reach summit-level trust an attacker must fund sustained genuine output per identity; costs scale with the oasis of active peers watching, not with count. Cloning 1,000 identities pays 1,000 full upkeep streams, not one gate fee.
